split: sha256 of all 23 feature values, excluding ID and Y; grouped identical profiles; 60% train, 10% calibration, 10% selection, 20% final
selection: maximum selection AP among three financial-input models, primary seed only; lexical tie break; no final reselection
pattern_selection: highest Wilson lower rate bound among train-grown leaves with selection support >=100; retain all candidates; no final refinement
pattern_variants: full; remove final predicate; numeric thresholds +/-5% train SD, one-hot thresholds unchanged; descriptive, no variant selection
final_use: single frozen evaluation; later reruns are reproduction, never fresh independent validation
limits: ID does not establish entity linkage
credit default is not payment fraud or false decline
no production value or causal effect
no historical risk score supplied; status_only is repayment history, not score_only
